sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》旗下每日新闻简报《DealBook》的商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上，现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯汀·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: We're driving past downtown, like pretty close to the port, and everything is just piles of glass and debris.
sentences.zh: 我们正开车经过市中心，离港口很近，到处都是玻璃和瓦砾堆。

sentences.en: And yeah, it's just storefronts like shoved over.
sentences.zh: 是的，店面都被推倒了。

sentences.en: And a hotel I was just near the other day is yeah, completely messed up.
sentences.zh: 我前几天还在附近的一家酒店，现在也彻底毁了。

sentences.en: In 2013, Lebanon's government detained a ship carrying 2,750 tons of a highly explosive chemical,
sentences.zh: 2013年，黎巴嫩政府扣押了一艘载有2750吨高爆炸性化学品——

sentences.en: ammonium nitrate.
sentences.zh: 硝酸铵的货船。

sentences.en: Despite the danger that the chemicals posed, the government transferred the giant shipment to a hangar in Beirut's port, blocks from the city's downtown and close to its
sentences.zh: 尽管这些化学品存在危险，政府还是将这批巨量货物转移到了贝鲁特港的一个机库中，距离市中心仅几个街区，且靠近

sentences.en: residential neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 居民区。

sentences.en: According to reporting by my colleague, Ben Hubbard, port authorities repeatedly asked the government to remove those chemicals, warning of the risks.
sentences.zh: 据我的同事本·哈伯德报道，港口当局曾多次要求政府移除这些化学品，并警告了相关风险。

sentences.en: But they remained there unprotected for the next six years.
sentences.zh: 但它们在接下来的六年里一直无人看管，留在了那里。

sentences.en: Then, this Tuesday, at 6.07pm local time, the ammonium nitrate combusted, triggering a series of explosions so powerful that the damage extended over half the city.
sentences.zh: 然后，本周二当地时间下午6点07分，硝酸铵发生燃烧，引发了一系列威力巨大的爆炸，破坏范围波及半个城市。

sentences.en: They leveled buildings, flipped cars, killed more than 135 people, injured 5,000 more, and left hundreds of thousands of people without housing.
sentences.zh: 爆炸夷平了建筑物，掀翻了汽车，造成超过135人死亡，5000多人受伤，数十万人无家可归。

sentences.en: For many in Lebanon, it was the culmination of years of mismanagement and neglect by the country's politicians.
sentences.zh: 对于许多黎巴嫩人来说，这是该国政客多年管理不善和玩忽职守的必然结果。

sentences.en: Times foreign correspondent Vivian
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》驻外记者薇薇安·

sentences.en: Yee has been reporting from Beirut since 2018, and she was at home in her apartment there on Tuesday evening.
sentences.zh: 伊自2018年起就在贝鲁特进行报道，周二晚上她当时就在那里的公寓里。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 6th.
sentences.zh: 现在是8月6日，星期四。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, August 4th, I had just gotten back from an interview, and I was
sentences.zh: 8月4日星期二，我刚采访回来，当时我正在

sentences.en: settling back into my home office, which faces the street, to catch up on the emails that I had missed while I was in a meeting.
sentences.zh: 回到我临街的家庭办公室，准备处理开会时错过的邮件。

sentences.en: And try to type out my notes.
sentences.zh: 并试着打出我的笔记。

sentences.en: And it was a typically beautiful looking Beirut August day, but terrible feeling in that it's incredibly humid in Beirut in AuguSt. We're right near the Mediterranean.
sentences.zh: 那是一个典型的贝鲁特八月的美好日子，但感觉却很糟糕，因为贝鲁特的八月极其潮湿。我们就在地中海附近。

sentences.en: You kind of feel like you're just sloshing around in your own sweat.
sentences.zh: 你感觉自己就像泡在汗水里一样。

sentences.en: So I was kind of alternately fanning myself and reading.
sentences.zh: 所以我一边扇风一边看书。

sentences.en: And pretty soon after I sat down, a friend of mine sent me a video over WhatsApp, and she said something like, the port seems to be burning.
sentences.zh: 我坐下没多久，一位朋友通过WhatsApp给我发了一段视频，她说港口好像着火了。

sentences.en: I was just about to try to load the video on my slow Beirut internet connection when I heard this deep, like, rattling my bones boom.
sentences.zh: 我正要用我那缓慢的贝鲁特网络连接加载视频时，听到了一声深沉的、震得我骨头都在响的巨响。

sentences.en: Like nothing I'd ever heard before in my entire life.
sentences.zh: 那是我一生中从未听过的声音。

sentences.en: And the building immediately started swaying back and forth.
sentences.zh: 建筑物随即开始前后摇晃。

sentences.en: And I grew up in
sentences.zh: 我在

sentences.en: California, so I know what an earthquake feels like.
sentences.zh: 加州长大，所以我知道地震是什么感觉。

sentences.en: And this felt like a bigger earthquake than I'd ever experienced in
sentences.zh: 而这次感觉比我在

sentences.en: California.
sentences.zh: 加州经历过的任何地震都要强烈。

sentences.en: I was obviously freaked out, so I ran to the windows to try to see if I could figure out what was going on.
sentences.zh: 我显然吓坏了，于是跑到窗边，想看看发生了什么事。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, the next thing I knew, there was another boom.
sentences.zh: 突然，我还没反应过来，又是一声巨响。

sentences.en: And that's when everything seemed to come apart.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，一切似乎都崩塌了。

sentences.en: And I was just caught in this torrent of broken, sharp things.
sentences.zh: 我被困在了一阵破碎、尖锐的物体洪流中。

sentences.en: And then things stopped moving.
sentences.zh: 然后一切停止了移动。

sentences.en: And I tried to get up and out from under the desk.
sentences.zh: 我试图起身从桌子底下爬出来。

sentences.en: And I opened my eyes, and I was having trouble seeing.
sentences.zh: 我睁开眼睛，发现视力出了问题。

sentences.en: Things were blurry, or things were kind of going in and out.
sentences.zh: 东西很模糊，或者说视线时有时无。

sentences.en: And as I blinked, I realized it was because my face was wet.
sentences.zh: 当我眨眼时，我意识到是因为我的脸湿了。

sentences.en: And I think I put my hand up to my forehead and realized that there was a huge gash that I could feel.
sentences.zh: 我想我把手放到额头上，感觉到了一道巨大的伤口。

sentences.en: And that it was blood pouring down my face.
sentences.zh: 鲜血正顺着我的脸流下来。

sentences.en: I sort of staggered up, and I could feel blood flowing from other places.
sentences.zh: 我踉踉跄跄地站起来，能感觉到其他地方也在流血。

sentences.en: And yeah, it was the moment when my vision just went wobbly, that I knew something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 是的，就在我视线变得模糊的那一刻，我知道出大事了。

sentences.en: And then within a few seconds, I realized, okay, my neighbors are running down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟内，我意识到，好吧，我的邻居们正在跑下楼梯。

sentences.en: Something else could be coming after this.
sentences.zh: 这之后可能还有别的事情发生。

sentences.en: And it's definitely not safe to stay in this smashed up place.
sentences.zh: 待在这个破碎的地方绝对不安全。

sentences.en: So I need to get out as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须尽快离开。

sentences.en: And so I made my way to my door.
sentences.zh: 于是我朝门口走去。

sentences.en: I have a yellow front door, or I had a yellow front door.
sentences.zh: 我有一扇黄色的前门，或者说我曾经有一扇黄色的前门。

sentences.en: And it was ripped from its hinges, and it was lying across my big dining room table.
sentences.zh: 它被从铰链上扯了下来，横在我的大餐桌上。

sentences.en: And my neighbors were running down the stairs, and they kind of gestured to me to follow.
sentences.zh: 邻居们正跑下楼梯，他们示意我跟上。

sentences.en: So all I could find were these really flimsy white espadrilles for shoes.
sentences.zh: 我只能找到一双非常单薄的白色草编鞋穿上。

sentences.en: I looked for something sturdier, and I couldn't find anything under the debris.
sentences.zh: 我找了些更结实的鞋子，但在瓦砾下什么也没找到。

sentences.en: There are these huge windows in my stairwell that had just been ripped clean from their frames and twisted and
sentences.zh: 楼梯间里有巨大的窗户，它们被从窗框上彻底扯下，扭曲并

sentences.en: smashed onto the stairs.
sentences.zh: 砸在楼梯上。

sentences.en: And so we had to kind of climb through and under the window frames to get out.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不得不爬过窗框下面才能出去。

sentences.en: And once I reached the street, I hesitated for a second because I was honestly so afraid of what I would find outside.
sentences.zh: 当我到达街道时，我犹豫了一秒钟，因为我真的非常害怕外面会是什么样子。

sentences.en: If it was this bad for me and my neighbors, it had to be much at least as bad for everybody else on the street.
sentences.zh: 如果我和邻居的情况都这么糟糕，街上的其他人肯定也一样。

sentences.en: And I had to take a moment to kind of steel myself for what I might see.
sentences.zh: 我必须花点时间让自己做好心理准备，去面对可能看到的景象。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序，第一个月即可免费使用。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间跨越付费墙，看看《纽约时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Once I got outside, it just, I mean, I had walked down that street 10, 15, 20 minutes before.
sentences.zh: 一旦我到了外面，我的意思是，我10、15、20分钟前才刚走过那条街。

sentences.en: This was the first day that people were allowed to be out and in businesses after a few days of coronavirus-related lockdown.
sentences.zh: 这是新冠疫情封锁几天后，人们被允许外出和进行商业活动的第一天。

sentences.en: So people had been out shopping.
sentences.zh: 所以人们都出来购物了。

sentences.en: They'd been going to restaurants early to make the most of, you know, one day when they could.
sentences.zh: 他们早早地去餐馆，想充分利用这难得的一天。

sentences.en: The storefronts looked like someone had just made a giant fist and, like, punched through every storefront.
sentences.zh: 店面看起来就像有人握紧了巨大的拳头，砸穿了每一家店。

sentences.en: And cars were kind of stranded here and there in the middle of the street.
sentences.zh: 汽车零零散散地停在街道中间。

sentences.en: And people were walking around sort of dazed and bloodied.
sentences.zh: 人们走来走去，显得神志不清，浑身是血。

sentences.en: My first thought was to try to see what was going on at the Red Cross, which is next door to me.
sentences.zh: 我的第一个念头是去看看隔壁的红十字会发生了什么。

sentences.en: And as soon as I looked in their windows, which were totally smashed, I thought, okay, there's no way anyone here can help me or anyone else.
sentences.zh: 当我看向他们完全破碎的窗户时，我想，好吧，这里没人能帮我或其他人了。

sentences.en: And the weirdest part was that the sky was still so blue at that point.
sentences.zh: 最奇怪的是，那一刻天空依然那么蓝。

sentences.en: Um, I never saw the, the mushroom cloud, um, that you see in the videos.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我没看到视频里那种蘑菇云。

sentences.en: I saw sort of the lingering smoke from it, but I just remember the street being, you know, it was almost golden hour.
sentences.zh: 我只看到了它留下的烟雾，但我记得街道当时处于黄金时刻。

sentences.en: So the light was just beautiful.
sentences.zh: 光线非常美。

sentences.en: And we were all just walking down the street.
sentences.zh: 我们都在街上走着。

sentences.en: It was chaos that people were going every which way.
sentences.zh: 到处一片混乱，人们四处奔逃。

sentences.en: No one knew exactly where to go.
sentences.zh: 没人知道确切该去哪里。

sentences.en: And this guy on a motorcycle comes up to me and he saw that my face was bloody, I guess.
sentences.zh: 这时一个骑摩托车的男人向我靠近，我想他看到我脸上流着血。

sentences.en: And he looked at me in just motion and, you know, for me to hop onto the back.
sentences.zh: 他看着我，示意我坐到后座上。

sentences.en: And we ended up picking up another guy who was even worse hurt than I was.
sentences.zh: 我们最终又载上了另一个人，他伤得比我还重。

sentences.en: Um, and so it was the three of us on this little motorbike trying to chug up to the nearest hospital.
sentences.zh: 于是我们三个人挤在这辆小摩托车上，努力向最近的医院赶去。

sentences.en: Really, it was, it was only motorbikes that were moving, uh, because the cars were stuck or frozen in place, or there was just too much traffic where they couldn't drive over all
sentences.zh: 真的，只有摩托车能动，因为汽车被困住或动弹不得，或者交通太拥堵，无法开过所有的

sentences.en: the debris.
sentences.zh: 瓦砾。

sentences.en: So we eventually had to stop a few blocks from the hospital and I walked the rest of the way.
sentences.zh: 所以我们最终不得不在离医院几个街区的地方停下，我步行走完了剩下的路。

sentences.en: But at a certain point, I realized that my shoes were full of broken glass too.
sentences.zh: 但在某个时刻，我意识到我的鞋子里也全是碎玻璃。

sentences.en: And, and everyone around me was in the same boat.
sentences.zh: 周围的每个人也都一样。

sentences.en: I saw people bleeding from the head, bleeding from their limbs, people who couldn't walk, people who were being carried, people who were sitting in chairs with,
sentences.zh: 我看到人们头部流血，四肢流血，有人无法行走，有人被抬着，有人坐在椅子上，

sentences.en: with tourniquets on their, on their thighs.
sentences.zh: 大腿上绑着止血带。

sentences.en: Because as it turned out, once I got to the hospital, that hospital was completely devastated.
sentences.zh: 因为事实证明，当我到达医院时，那家医院已经彻底被毁了。

sentences.en: I learned later that, uh, it lost several nurses and a few patients who were on ventilators at the time of the explosion.
sentences.zh: 后来我得知，它失去了几名护士和几名在爆炸发生时正在使用呼吸机的病人。

sentences.en: Um, and when the hospital got blown out and, and the power went out, those patients died.
sentences.zh: 当医院被炸毁，电力中断时，那些病人就去世了。

sentences.en: So they weren't accepting any new patients.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不再接收任何新病人。

sentences.en: That became clear pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 这一点很快就变得很清楚了。

sentences.en: So a lot of us were just kind of wandering around, wondering what to do next.
sentences.zh: 所以我们很多人只是在附近徘徊，不知道下一步该做什么。

sentences.en: And it was outside the emergency room there that I, I ran into a total stranger who sort of grabbed me by the arm and was trying to help me get into the emergency room.
sentences.zh: 就在急诊室外，我遇到了一个完全陌生的人，他抓着我的胳膊，试图帮我进入急诊室。

sentences.en: But when we realized that that that wasn't going to work out, he had me sit down on some stairs and he kind of wiped me off
sentences.zh: 但当我们意识到行不通时，他让我坐在楼梯上，帮我擦拭身体，

sentences.en: and somewhere found a bandage and put it around my forehead, gave me some water.
sentences.zh: 不知从哪儿找来绷带包扎了我的额头，还给了我一些水。

sentences.en: And, uh, then he was off to look for his friend.
sentences.zh: 然后他就去寻找他的朋友了。

sentences.en: I kept wandering, kept walking.
sentences.zh: 我继续徘徊，继续行走。

sentences.en: Uh, I was trying to get in touch with colleagues and with friends to see whether everyone was okay.
sentences.zh: 我试图联系同事和朋友，看看大家是否平安。

sentences.en: I wasn't getting through to a few of my friends, which was incredibly scary.
sentences.zh: 我联系不上几个朋友，这非常可怕。

sentences.en: And so I just walked deeper into the neighborhood, hoping to see if I could get to a main road and flag a taxi to somehow take me to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 所以我深入社区，希望能找到一条主路，拦一辆出租车把我送去医院。

sentences.en: But I didn't know how likely that was given that the roads seemed to be jammed and I'm sure everybody else was doing the same thing as me.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道这有多大可能，因为道路似乎堵死了，我相信其他人也在做同样的事。

sentences.en: So, uh, I'm not sure I had a great plan at that point.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不确定当时我有什么好计划。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 而且

sentences.en: again, I got lucky.
sentences.zh: 我又幸运了一次。

sentences.en: I ran into a friend of a friend and he was cleaning up the debris around his house and he saw me and waved me over and gave me water and looked at the rest of my wounds and,
sentences.zh: 我遇到了一个朋友的朋友，他正在清理房子周围的瓦砾，他看到我后向我招手，给了我水，检查了我其他的伤口，

sentences.en: you know, cleaned the rest of them and even disinfected them with Atta, which is, uh, a Lebanese
sentences.zh: 清理了伤口，甚至用Atta给我消毒，这是一种黎巴嫩的

sentences.en: anise seed flavored, um, liquor and told me jokes, distracted me, bandaged me with what we had on hand, which was not much.
sentences.zh: 茴香酒，还给我讲笑话，分散我的注意力，用手头仅有的东西给我包扎，其实也没多少东西。

sentences.en: And that's when my colleague Ben Hubbard found me.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我的同事本·哈伯德找到了我。

sentences.en: And we basically were just by the side of the road trying to see if anyone would stop and take us to the hospital because it was so hard to get any transportation.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上就站在路边，看有没有人能停下来带我们去医院，因为很难找到交通工具。

sentences.en: So finally this, this guy in an SUV just pulls over and agreed to drive us to one of the few, um, hospitals that was still accepting new patients because every hospital
sentences.zh: 最后，一个开SUV的人停了下来，同意开车送我们去少数几家仍在接收新病人的医院之一，因为该地区的每家医院

sentences.en: in the area was totally overrun.
sentences.zh: 都人满为患。

sentences.en: And once we got to the hospital, again, it was complete chaos.
sentences.zh: 当我们到达医院时，又是一片混乱。

sentences.en: People were just lying on the floor or, or sitting in bloody armchairs.
sentences.zh: 人们躺在地板上，或者坐在沾满血迹的扶手椅上。

sentences.en: There seemed to be no sort of system for getting in.
sentences.zh: 似乎没有任何入院系统。

sentences.en: And then Hoida, who is our Lebanese reporter based here and an all-around
sentences.zh: 然后，我们的黎巴嫩记者Hoida，一个全能的

sentences.en: Wonder Woman, she shows up and kind of just takes me by the hand and flags down a doctor and pulls me inside.
sentences.zh: 神奇女侠，她出现了，拉着我的手，拦住了一位医生，把我拉了进去。

sentences.en: And that's when they put staples on my arms, down one leg and all across my forehead.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他们给我的手臂、一条腿和整个额头缝了钉子。

sentences.en: Um, so it's after midnight in Beirut, uh, on late Wednesday night or early Thursday morning.
sentences.zh: 现在是贝鲁特午夜过后，周三深夜或周四凌晨。

sentences.en: And I just got back to my coworker, Ben Hubbard's apartment in Beirut, which thankfully wasn't
sentences.zh: 我刚回到同事本·哈伯德在贝鲁特的公寓，谢天谢地，这里没有

sentences.en: affected by the blaSt. Um, I just got home from going to another hospital because 24 hours later,
sentences.zh: 受到爆炸的影响。我刚从另一家医院回来，因为24小时后，

sentences.en: or I guess more like 30 hours later, someone took a look at my forehead and figured that the,
sentences.zh: 或者说30小时后，有人看了看我的额头，发现

sentences.en: the staples weren't put in properly because they were done in such a rush because the ER was overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 钉子没钉好，因为急诊室太拥挤，当时太匆忙了。

sentences.en: And so I had to get it restitched, but everything should be fine now.
sentences.zh: 所以我不得不重新缝合，但现在应该没问题了。

sentences.en: And I think driving back from the hospital into Beirut, seeing all the destruction, it just, it hit me.
sentences.zh: 我想开车从医院回贝鲁特的路上，看到所有的破坏，我真的被震撼了。

sentences.en: Um, it really hit me or it was starting to hit me.
sentences.zh: 它真的击中了我，或者说开始击中我了。

sentences.en: I had been running on adrenaline yesterday and
sentences.zh: 昨天我一直靠肾上腺素支撑，

sentences.en: I'm starting to, I think we're all starting to reckon with the scale of the damage and to just think
sentences.zh: 我想我们所有人都在开始面对破坏的规模，并思考

sentences.en: even in the best of times, this would be hard to come back from, but Beirut is in the middle of this
sentences.zh: 即使在最好的时候，这也难以恢复，但贝鲁特正处于这场

sentences.en: deep, deep economic crisis that was already hard to see your way out of before this.
sentences.zh: 深重的经济危机之中，在此之前就已经很难看到出路了。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 而

sentences.en: I just don't know how people are going to even begin to bounce back in terms of the damage to their,
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道人们将如何开始从他们的损失中恢复过来。

sentences.en: to their houses, to their businesses.
sentences.zh: 去到他们的家里，去到他们的商铺。

sentences.en: I think it's a cliche to say, but it's also very true that
sentences.zh: 我觉得说这种话虽然是老生常谈，但确实非常真实，那就是

sentences.en: Lebanon has been through so much.
sentences.zh: 黎巴嫩经历得太多了。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't know how people can survive all that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我不知道人们怎么能从这一切中幸存下来。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 而且

sentences.en: then, you know, joke around with the person they're, they're patching up right after
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，在经历了一场

sentences.en: a huge, terrifying explosion.
sentences.zh: 巨大而恐怖的爆炸之后，还能和他们正在包扎伤口的人开玩笑。

sentences.en: I just don't know how you develop that resilience and that, and that humor.
sentences.zh: 我只是不知道你们是如何培养出那种韧性和那种幽默感的。

sentences.en: I think some Lebanese would say, well, well, that's, that's why, because we can't live life just in fear and, and looking over our shoulders, the only way that we have been
sentences.zh: 我想一些黎巴嫩人会说，嗯，这就是原因，因为我们不能只生活在恐惧中，不能总是提心吊胆，我们能够

sentences.en: able to survive this country is to be resilient.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家生存下去的唯一方式就是保持韧性。

sentences.en: But as one of my Lebanese friends has been saying about the economic crisis, maybe there comes a point where, where resilience is, is not a virtue,
sentences.zh: 但正如我的一位黎巴嫩朋友在谈到经济危机时所说的那样，也许在某个时刻，韧性不再是一种美德，

sentences.en: where people need to recognize that things won't be okay unless something changes.
sentences.zh: 人们需要意识到，除非发生改变，否则事情不会好转。

sentences.en: And if it's true that as the government is saying, this explosion was due to just this colossal failure of management,
sentences.zh: 如果正如政府所说，这次爆炸仅仅是因为管理上的巨大失误，

sentences.en: just real incompetence, then I think if the government had any credibility left, and I, and I don't think it did, that would destroy the last shred of it.
sentences.zh: 纯粹是无能，那么我认为，如果政府还有任何信誉可言——我不认为还有——那也会被彻底摧毁。

sentences.en: So tomorrow I'll try to get back into my apartment, try to get back to the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 所以明天我会试着回到我的公寓，试着回到那个街区。

sentences.en: And I've been told that my building, along with a lot of others, might collapse.
sentences.zh: 有人告诉我，我的大楼和其他许多建筑一样，可能会倒塌。

sentences.en: So we'll see.
sentences.zh: 所以我们走着瞧吧。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the acting inspector general of the State Department resigned, less than three months
sentences.zh: 周三，美国国务院代理监察长辞职，距离他接替前任监察长还不到三个月，

sentences.en: after replacing the previous inspector general, who was fired by President Trump after he opened investigations into Secretary of State Mike Pompeo.
sentences.zh: 而前任监察长在对国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥展开调查后被特朗普总统解雇。

sentences.en: The State Department gave no explanation for the departure, but it immediately raised questions about whether the Trump administration is driving
sentences.zh: 国务院没有对此次离职做出解释，但这立即引发了人们的质疑：特朗普政府是否正在驱逐

sentences.en: out internal watchdogs, whose job it is to hold cabinet members accountable for their actions.
sentences.zh: 内部的监督者，而他们的职责正是让内阁成员对其行为负责。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: Today, the people of St. Louis made a decision.
sentences.zh: 今天，圣路易斯的人民做出了决定。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: From all corners of Missouri's 1st District,
sentences.zh: 来自密苏里州第一选区的各个角落，

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Our communities have embraced a bold, fearless vision of real change, where regular, everyday people like us can feel it.
sentences.zh: 我们的社区拥抱了一种大胆、无畏的真正变革愿景，像我们这样的普通人都能感受到。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Today, the people won.
sentences.zh: 今天，人民赢了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Progressive Democrats have won a series of closely-watched congressional primaries in Missouri and Michigan, highlighting their growing influence within the party.
sentences.zh: 进步派民主党人在密苏里州和密歇根州赢得了一系列备受瞩目的国会初选，凸显了他们在党内日益增长的影响力。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So let me just say, it is historic that this year of all years,
sentences.zh: 所以请允许我说，在今年这个特殊的年份，这具有历史意义，

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We're sending a black, working-class, single mother who's been fighting for black lives from Ferguson all the way to the Hall of the Congress!
sentences.zh: 我们正要把一位黑人、工薪阶层、单身母亲送进国会大厅，她从弗格森开始就一直为黑人的生命而战！

sentences.en: In Missouri, Cori Bush, an activist who has protested police brutality, defeated Democratic Representative William Lacey Clay Jr.,
sentences.zh: 在密苏里州，一直抗议警察暴力的活动人士科里·布什击败了民主党众议员威廉·莱西·克莱二世，

sentences.en: a 10-term incumbent whose family had represented the St. Louis area for more than 50 years.
sentences.zh: 他是一位连任十届的在职议员，其家族代表圣路易斯地区已超过50年。

sentences.en: And in Michigan, Representative Rashida Tlaib, an outspoken liberal, easily fended off a challenge from Detroit's moderate city council leader, Brenda Jones,
sentences.zh: 而在密歇根州，直言不讳的自由派众议员拉希达·特莱布轻松击败了来自底特律的温和派市议会领袖布伦达·琼斯的挑战，

sentences.en: to win a second term in the House.
sentences.zh: 赢得了众议院的第二个任期。

sentences.en: In a statement, Tlaib said that her district was, quote, done waiting for transformative change, adding, they want an unapologetic fighter.
sentences.zh: 特莱布在一份声明中表示，她的选区“受够了等待变革”，并补充说：“他们想要一个毫不妥协的斗士。”

sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时甚至令人兴奋的斗争中。
